description: Persist assistant settings from chat page + per-session subagent selection

userStories.title: Save as Assistant dialog component
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dialog that prompts me for a name and description when saving current settings as an assistant.
acceptanceCriteria: Create frontend/src/components/dialogs/SaveAsAssistantDialog.tsx with name (required) and description inputs
Dialog has Save and Cancel buttons
Name field validates non-empty
Dialog accepts an onSave callback with name and description
Typecheck passes with tsc --project tsconfig.app.json
userStories.notes: Implemented in prior WIP commit. All acceptance criteria verified.

userStories.title: Wire Save as Assistant to chat page
userStories.description: As a user, from the chat page I want to persist the current state of settings as an assistant.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Save as Assistant action accessible from the chat page (e.g., in ChatNav or agent-section area)
On click, open SaveAsAssistantDialog
On save, collect current agent state (model, tools, prompt, mcp, a2a, subagents, files) and POST to /assistants via AgentService.createAssistant()
On success, show toast notification and refresh agent list
On error, show error toast
Typecheck passes with tsc --project tsconfig.app.json
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill
userStories.notes: Save button added to ChatNav with Save icon. Opens SaveAsAssistantDialog, collects agent state, POSTs via AgentService.create(), shows toast, refreshes agents.

userStories.title: Subagent selection modal component
userStories.description: As a user, I want a modal to select which subagents to use in my current session.
acceptanceCriteria: Create subagent selection UI (new modal or new tab in ToolSelectionModal)
Display available agents from the agents list with name, description, and model info
Each agent has a toggle to add/remove as a subagent for the current session
Show currently selected subagents with visual indicator
Typecheck passes with tsc --project tsconfig.app.json
userStories.notes: Added Subagents tab to ToolSelectionModal with SubagentsPanel component. Shows agent grid with name/description/model, toggle selection, visual indicator (primary bg + check icon).

userStories.title: Wire subagent selection to chat page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to select subagents from the chat page and have them included in my LLM requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Add subagent selection trigger in BaseToolMenu or adjacent to it in the chat input area
Wire selection to existing useAgent toggleSubagent/addAgentToSubagents/removeAgentFromSubagents methods
Verify selected subagents are included in the LLM request payload (useChat sends agent.subagents)
Typecheck passes with tsc --project tsconfig.app.json
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill
userStories.notes: Already wired via US-003: BaseToolMenu -> Configure Tools -> ToolSelectionModal -> Subagents tab. Uses toggleSubagent/isAgentSelected from AgentContext. useChat sends agent.subagents at lines 226 and 334.
